t: You're looking at a pink granite memorial in the old churchyard of St Mary Aldermanbury, on Love Lane. It honours John Heminges and Henry Condell, two actors in the King's Men, the company Shakespeare wrote for. They edited his First Folio, published in 1623. Heminges also managed the company's money. At the top is a bust of Shakespeare by the sculptor C. J. Allen, dated 1895.
